description: This file implements various classes and protocols for checkpoint staging in PyTorch distributed training, including asynchronous and blocking staging, with support for shared memory, pinned memory, and distributed replication.

classes.name: AsyncStager
classes.description: Protocol defining the interface for checkpoint staging, supporting asynchronous and customizable staging operations.

classes.name: StagingOptions
classes.description: Configuration dataclass for checkpoint staging options such as pinned memory, shared memory, async staging, and non-blocking copy.

classes.name: DefaultStager
classes.description: Default implementation of AsyncStager with full features including async/sync staging, resource cleanup, and optional resource synchronization.

classes.name: BlockingAsyncStager
classes.description: Implementation of AsyncStager that stages on CPU RAM synchronously, with optional caching and pinned memory support.

classes.name: _ReplicationStager
classes.description: Experimental AsyncStager that replicates state_dict across distributed ranks using PGTransport.

methods.name: stage
methods.description: Stages the provided state_dict, either asynchronously returning a Future or synchronously returning the staged dict.

methods.name: _stage
methods.description: Internal method to perform the actual staging operation, handling non-blocking copies and stream synchronization.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the stager, such as thread pools and cached storages.

methods.name: synchronize_staging
methods.description: Waits for staging to complete if asynchronous; no-op if staging is synchronous.

methods.name: stage
methods.description: Returns a CPU copy of the state_dict, optionally caching it for reuse.

methods.name: _persist_state_dict
methods.description: Persists a received state_dict to disk with atomic rename for future discoverability.

methods.name: _get_persisted_path
methods.description: Generates the file path for persisting a state_dict based on rank and partner rank.
